calibration.source: probe scores of the normal Val cases (run wp5_structure_delta, own partition)

dataset: DELTA (figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.32358771, CC BY 4.0): probe fitted on the Train split (521 cases), calibrated on the normal cases of the Val split
intended_input: a folder with one image of each plane, named Abdomen, 4CH, LVOT, RVOT and 3VT (.jpg, .png or .bmp); every image is cleaned by sfr.echo.deidentify before it is embedded
known_limits: one open dataset from one centre (DELTA); inputs with little or no cardiac anatomy also separate the classes (AUROC 0.619 to 0.770, run wp5_structure_delta), so its performance is an upper bound on what heart structure contributes
defects caught by image size: 60 of 114 in 900x752; 0 of 11 in 642x506 (run wp9_checks_after_results, cross-validated probe)
the run computed its embeddings on a GPU; on a CPU they differ in the last digits (tests/test_predict.py checks the agreement)
